rule: a field only one add-on declares, spelled in camel case
why: ONE, `'maturesOn'` in `packages/host/src`, where `vault` alone declares the field `matures_on`: a name's own separators do not count. `decoy.ts` spells `label`, a field id of five letters, and `amount`, which both planted add-ons declare, and neither is a finding: those two rules are all that holds the field pass back from every common word.
